```sql
WITH s AS (
    SELECT sku_id, is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE sku_code = 'SW3-120WHT12-JPP-78'
),
skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKU: map directly
    SELECT sku_id
    FROM s
    WHERE NOT COALESCE(is_bundle, FALSE)

    UNION

    -- Bundle SKU: map through its item SKUs
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id
    FROM s
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE COALESCE(s.is_bundle, FALSE)
)
SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code
FROM skus
JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = skus.sku_id
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id
ORDER BY cm.model_code;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base: direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON mb.model_id = cm.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        bom.total_qty * cbom.qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN component_bom cbom ON bom.component_id = cbom.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cbom.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE bom.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cbom.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cbom.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cbom.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(total_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom
WHERE component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'
  AND is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the bundle SKU
bundle_sku AS (
    SELECT sku_id
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-UK-0139'
),
-- 2. Get item SKUs from the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM bundle_sku)
),
-- 3. Map item SKUs to models
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- 4. Start recursive BOM traversal from models
bom_traversal AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of models
    SELECT 
        im.model_id,
        im.bundle_qty * im.model_qty AS path_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS comp_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of assemblies
    SELECT 
        bt.model_id,
        bt.path_qty * cb.qty AS path_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty
    FROM bom_traversal bt
    JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
-- 5. Sum up quantities for the specific part
SELECT 
    SUM(bt.path_qty * bt.comp_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_traversal bt
JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FAS-956-BLK-01640'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the bundle SKU
bundle_sku AS (
    SELECT sku_id
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-US-0239' AND is_bundle = TRUE
),
-- 2. Get item SKUs in the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM bundle_sku)
),
-- 3. Get models for each item SKU
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- 4. Get top-level components for each model (current BOM)
top_components AS (
    SELECT 
        im.item_sku_id,
        im.bundle_qty,
        im.model_id,
        im.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS comp_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- 5. Recursively expand assemblies to find all parts
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: top-level components
    SELECT 
        tc.item_sku_id,
        tc.bundle_qty,
        tc.model_id,
        tc.model_qty,
        tc.component_id,
        tc.comp_qty AS total_qty
    FROM top_components tc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.item_sku_id,
        be.bundle_qty,
        be.model_id,
        be.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        be.total_qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
-- 6. Sum up quantities for the specific part
SELECT 
    SUM(be.total_qty * be.bundle_qty * be.model_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_expansion be
JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CAB-573-GRY-01774'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, s2.is_bundle, st.mult * bi.qty, st.depth + 1
    FROM sku_tree st
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = st.sku_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE params AS (

explode AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty, 1 AS depth

    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base: direct components in model BOM (current)
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

    -- Recursive: expand assemblies via component BOM (current)

        be.model_id,

        be.total_qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = be.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = c.component_id

      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)

    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN models_with_part mwp ON mwp.model_id = sm.model_id
```

```sql
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
),

-- 4. Expand bundles to get the actual SKUs sold
-- For non-bundles, the SKU is itself.
-- For bundles, we need to look at bundle_item to find the item SKUs.
-- We treat the "effective SKU" as the one that maps to models.

    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * 1 AS effective_qty,
        ol.sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS effective_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.effective_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty,
        sm.model_id
    FROM effective_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-148-WAL-02453'
),

-- 2. Find the store
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM store
    WHERE store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
),

-- 3. Get completed orders for the target store in 2023
base_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- 4. Expand SKUs to Models (handling bundles)
-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct mapping via sku_model
-- For bundle SKUs: expand via bundle_item to item SKUs, then to models
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.order_date,
        bo.line_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bo.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bo.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.order_date,
        bo.line_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty * bi.qty AS model_qty
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bo.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bo.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
),

-- 5. Recursive CTE to explode Model BOM and Component BOM
-- We need to track the total quantity multiplier from the order line down to the component.
-- Start with Model -> Component (Level 0)
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Level 0: Model BOM
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.line_qty * sm.model_qty AS total_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS comp_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive Step: Component BOM (Assembly -> Child Component)
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN component_bom cb ON be.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE be.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- 6. Sum up the quantities for the target part
SELECT 
    SUM(be.total_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_exploded be
JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.component_id
WHERE be.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
),
```

```sql
-- Non-bundle SKUs map directly to models
-- Bundle SKUs map to item SKUs which map to models
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.order_date,
        bo.line_qty,
        mb.model_id,
        mb.qty AS model_qty
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bo.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON s.sku_id = mb.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE
      AND mb.valid_from <= bo.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR bo.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.order_date,
        bo.line_qty,
        mb.model_id,
        mb.qty * bi.qty AS model_qty
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bo.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON s.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item_s ON bi.item_sku_id = item_s.sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON item_s.sku_id = mb.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND mb.valid_from <= bo.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR bo.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- 5. Recursive CTE to explode BOM from Models down to Parts
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base case: Model -> Component (Level 0)
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.line_qty,
        sm.model_qty,
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        mb.qty AS path_qty
    FROM sku_to_model sm

    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive case: Assembly -> Component (Level N)
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.line_qty,
        be.model_qty,
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        be.path_qty * cbom.qty AS path_qty
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN component_bom cbom ON be.component_id = cbom.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cbom.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE be.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cbom.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (cbom.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cbom.valid_to)
)

-- 6. Sum up the quantities for the target part
SELECT 
    SUM(be.line_qty * be.model_qty * be.path_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_exploded be
JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.component_id
WHERE be.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the target part ID
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'CAB-563-BLK-01890'
),

-- Get the store ID
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM store
    WHERE store_name = 'Shopify-DE-21'
),

-- Get completed orders for the target store in 2024
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        co.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN completed_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for each order line, get the effective SKUs (non-bundle)
-- A non-bundle SKU maps directly; a bundle SKU expands to its item SKUs
effective_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * 1 AS effective_qty,
        ol.sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku s ON ol.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS effective_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku s ON ol.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map effective SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.effective_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM effective_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Now we need to trace the BOM from each model down to the target part
-- Start with model-level components
bom_trace AS (
    -- Level 0: model -> component
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.effective_qty * sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS path_qty,
        mb.component_id
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component -> child component (for assemblies)
    SELECT 
        bt.order_id,
        bt.order_date,
        bt.path_qty * cb.qty AS path_qty,
        cb.child_component_id
    FROM bom_trace bt
    JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= bt.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR bt.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up all quantities for the target part
SELECT 
    SUM(bt.path_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_trace bt
JOIN target_part tp ON bt.component_id = tp.component_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Map each SKU to its constituent models and quantities
sku_model_map AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: direct mapping
    SELECT
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku s ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs: expand through bundle_item to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku s_item ON bi.item_sku_id = s_item.sku_id
    WHERE s_item.is_bundle = FALSE
),
-- 2. Get completed orders in CA in 2023
ca_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),
-- 3. Join to listings to get SKU, then to sku_model_map to get models
model_units AS (
    SELECT
        smm.model_id,
        SUM(co.order_line_qty * smm.sku_model_qty) AS total_units
    FROM ca_orders_2023 co
    JOIN listing l ON co.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sku_model_map smm ON l.sku_id = smm.sku_id
    GROUP BY smm.model_id
)
SELECT
    cm.model_code
FROM model_units mu
JOIN company_model cm ON mu.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY mu.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
    FROM sales_sku s
    UNION ALL
```
```sql
    SELECT e.root_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id, e.mult * bi.qty, s2.is_bundle
    FROM sku_expand e
```
```sql
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = e.sku_id
```

```sql
    GROUP BY e.root_sku_id, sm.model_id

    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sku_model_units smu ON smu.root_sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'US'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY smu.model_id
```

```sql
-- First, find all composition paths from SKUs to the target model
-- Path: sku -> model (direct, non-bundle)
-- Path: bundle_sku -> item_sku -> model

-- Let's build a recursive CTE that starts from the target model and goes UP to find all parent SKUs
-- But composition edges are parent -> child. So model is a child of SKU.
-- We need to find all SKUs that have this model as a descendant.

-- Alternative approach: Start from all SKUs, expand down to models, and check if target model is reached.
-- But that's expensive. Let's go upward from the model.

-- u_composition: parent_kind, parent_code, child_kind, child_code, qty
-- For a model, its parents are SKUs (non-bundle) or item SKUs (which are children of bundle SKUs)

-- Let's define a recursive CTE that finds all ancestors of the target model, tracking the cumulative quantity multiplier.

model_ancestors AS (
    -- Base case: direct parents of the model
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_kind,
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.qty AS path_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.child_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.child_code = 'CO6-140GRY29-0320'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: parents of the parent
    SELECT 
        uc2.parent_kind,
        uc2.parent_code,
        ma.path_qty * uc2.qty,
        ma.depth + 1
    FROM model_ancestors ma
    JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.child_kind = ma.parent_kind 
                          AND uc2.child_code = ma.parent_code
    WHERE uc2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc2.valid_to)
      AND ma.depth < 10  -- safety limit
)

-- Now, from model_ancestors, we have all SKUs (both direct and via bundles) that contain the target model
-- We need to filter to only those where parent_kind = 'sku'
-- Then join with listings, order_lines, and orders to get sold quantities

SELECT 
    SUM(ol.qty * ma.path_qty) AS total_units_sold
FROM model_ancestors ma
JOIN listing l ON l.sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = ma.parent_code)
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE ma.parent_kind = 'sku'
```

```sql
        c.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_code = 'NO7-180WAL49-0340'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    -- First level: bundle SKU -> item SKU
    SELECT 
        bs.sku_id,
        bs.sku_code,
        c1.qty * c2.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku bs
    JOIN u_composition c1 ON c1.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c1.parent_code = bs.sku_code
    JOIN sales_sku isku ON isku.sku_code = c1.child_code AND isku.is_bundle = FALSE
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c2.parent_code = isku.sku_code
    WHERE bs.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND c1.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c2.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c2.child_code = 'NO7-180WAL49-0340'
      AND c1.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c1.valid_to IS NULL OR c1.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
      AND c2.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)

SELECT 
    SUM(ol.qty * sm.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sku_to_model sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
```

```sql
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

        c1.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,

        c2.parent_code AS item_sku_code,
        c2.qty AS item_qty_per_model
    FROM u_composition c1
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c1.child_code = c2.parent_code
    WHERE c1.parent_kind = 'sku'

      AND c2.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Start from the target model, find all SKUs that contain it (directly or via bundles)
-- We need to trace: model -> non-bundle SKU (reverse) and model -> bundle SKU (reverse via item SKUs)
-- Actually, let's think forward: SKU -> model, and bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
-- We want all SKUs that contribute to this model, then sum qty * order_line.qty

-- First, find all composition paths from SKUs to the target model
-- Path: sku -> model (direct, non-bundle)
-- Path: bundle_sku -> item_sku -> model

-- Let's build a recursive CTE that starts from the target model and goes UP to find all parent SKUs
-- But composition edges go parent -> child. So model is a child of SKU.
-- We need to find all SKUs that have this model as a descendant.

-- Alternative approach: For each completed order line in 2024, find the SKU, then determine how many units of the target model are in that SKU.

-- Let's compute for each SKU the total quantity of the target model per unit of that SKU.

-- Step 1: Find direct mappings: non-bundle SKU -> model
-- Step 2: Find bundle mappings: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model

-- Let's use a recursive CTE to expand from SKUs down to models, tracking cumulative quantity.

sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_code = 'SW4-120BLK46-0337'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    -- We need to find bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs which map to the target model
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        bc.qty * ic.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bc ON bc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND bc.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND bc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND bc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (bc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= bc.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku item_sku ON item_sku.sku_code = bc.child_code
    JOIN u_composition ic ON ic.parent_kind = 'sku' AND ic.parent_code = item_sku.sku_code
        AND ic.child_kind = 'model'
        AND ic.child_code = 'SW4-120BLK46-0337'
        AND ic.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (ic.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= ic.valid_to)
    WHERE b.is_bundle = TRUE
)

SELECT 
    SUM(ol.qty * sm.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sku_to_model sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
```

```sql
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
```

```sql
        b.order_id,
```
```sql
        b.line_qty * 1.0 AS total_qty,
        b.sku_code AS current_code,

        uc.child_kind,
        bom.order_date

        AND bom.current_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= bom.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bom.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

        bom.order_id,

        AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
        AND uc.valid_from <= bom.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bom.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

    SELECT
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_exp AS (
    -- start: each sold SKU maps to itself
    SELECT s.sku_code AS root_sku, s.sku_code AS cur_sku, 1::BIGINT AS mult
    FROM sales_sku s
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKU -> item SKU
    SELECT e.root_sku, c.child_code, e.mult * c.qty
    FROM sku_exp e
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = e.cur_sku
     AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
),
sku_model AS (
    SELECT e.root_sku, c.child_code AS model_code, SUM(e.mult * c.qty) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sku_exp e
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = e.cur_sku
     AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    GROUP BY e.root_sku, c.child_code
),
sold AS (
    SELECT sk.sku_code, SUM(ol.qty) AS units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o   ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store st   ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing l  ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'US'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY sk.sku_code
)
SELECT sm.model_code
FROM sold s
JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.root_sku = s.sku_code
GROUP BY sm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(s.units * sm.qty_per_unit) DESC, sm.model_code
LIMIT 3;
```
